title: Pro Shop Store Credit: refund window and account-closure terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's refund and closure facet across every tier: the standing number of days after a top-up within which that top-up may be refunded, the standing percentage of an eligible top-up refunded, the smallest unused balance eligible for a cash refund at closure, the percentage of an unused balance forfeited on closure rather than refunded, the notice required before a closure request takes effect, and whether an unused balance may be transferred to another member's account on death or closure rather than forfeited.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Refund window | Refund percentage | Smallest closure refund eligible | Forfeiture percentage below that floor | Closure notice required | Transferable on death or closure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 7 days | 100 percent | 5.00 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | No |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 7 days | 100 percent | 5.00 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | No |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 10 days | 100 percent | 5.00 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | Yes |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 14 days | 100 percent | 0 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | Yes |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 7 days | 100 percent | 5.00 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | No |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 10 days | 100 percent | 0 USD | 0 percent | 0 days | Yes |

## Points of reference
- The refund window and the refund percentage shown here are each tier's own standing figures; a separate document covers the current basis on which a refund is actually recorded.
- The smallest closure refund eligible is the floor below which an unused balance at closure is treated under the forfeiture percentage rather than paid out in cash; a tier showing 0 USD carries no such floor, so any unused balance clears the floor.
- No tier currently sets a positive forfeiture percentage or a positive closure-notice requirement.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tiers currently carry no floor below which a closure refund is treated as a forfeiture?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium, each showing a smallest closure refund eligible of 0 USD.
**Is the refund percentage the same across every tier?** Yes, every tier currently states a refund percentage of 100 percent.
